data.name: Trainferno
data.detailed_description:
Trainferno is a compact side-scrolling survival game that lives in the corner of your screen.
Keep your train alive while working, watching videos, or browsing the web — danger never stops, and neither does your journey.

The world outside is hostile. Resources are scarce. Enemies attack without warning.
Your train is your last refuge — and your only weapon.

Mount turrets, upgrade defenses, and survive relentless enemy waves.

  • Build and position automated turrets

  • Defend against creatures, raiders, and unknown threats

  • Manage ammo and power under constant pressure

  • Watch your train fight — even while you're busy with other tasks

Every second counts. Every mistake costs.

Your train evolves as you do.

  • Upgrade compartments and systems

  • Improve weapons and defenses

  • Unlock new modules and tactical options

  • Customize your survival strategy

A stronger train means a longer journey.

♾️ Endless Loot and Item Variety

Discover an unlimited variety of loot, weapons, and upgrades that constantly reshape your strategy.

🧠 Intelligent Enemies That Avoid Becoming Targets

Face smart enemies that actively avoid danger, reposition themselves, and force you to rethink your defenses.

☢️ A Harsh Post-Apocalyptic World

Travel through a devastated world filled with danger, scarcity, and constant threats beyond the tracks.

🚉 Missions and Trading at Stations

Stop at stations to choose missions, trade resources, and prepare your train for the dangers ahead.

⚙️ Deep Train Customization and Tactical Freedom

Upgrade wagons, swap weapons, and recruit specialized personnel.
Every mission offers endless tactical possibilities.

🔁 Infinite Replayability

No two missions are ever the same.
Procedural encounters ensure limitless replay value.

Trainferno is built to run alongside your daily computer use.

Play it while:

  • Working

  • Watching videos

  • Browsing the internet

  • Doing literally anything else on your PC

Move the game window anywhere — any corner, any time.

It doesn't interrupt your workflow.
It becomes part of it.
